blocking_rules: A gap may not be closed by copying an inherited scenario under a new ID.
Every closure case must cite its nearest inherited anchor and state the material differential.
An expected oracle may only assert behavior already governed by owning sources; otherwise it must assert unsupported/indeterminate/source-gap behavior.
P15-GAP-001/F024 remains open and cannot receive invented lifecycle behavior.
Scale fixtures are deterministic QA inputs, never product capacity promises.
PPIA-11 balance cases may return uncertainty or indeterminate_blocked and may never certify guaranteed balance.
No PPIA-15 case activates application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, tester access, release, deployment, paid service or production credentials.
